issues.title: Order confirmation email not received
issues.problem_statement: The customer had connected their payment gateway, but their customers were not receiving the order confirmation email after they bought.

issues.title: Default sender name on confirmation email
issues.problem_statement: The order confirmation email still shows the default sender name, and the customer wants to use their brand name instead.

items.description: Customer switched on the order confirmation email toggle in the product's settings and saved it, following support's guidance, then placed a test order and confirmed the confirmation email arrived in their inbox.
evidence: Let's switch it on and save.
the confirmation email just arrived in my inbox!

items.description: Support pointed out that the email still shows the default sender name and that it can be changed under Email settings, Sender name.
evidence: the email still shows the default sender name
You can change it under Email settings, Sender name.

items.description: Customer will change the sender name to their brand name under Email settings, after the call.
evidence: I'll change that myself after the call

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
